description: Pouch.me: a starting bag size from the same sizing tool as pouch.me/bag-sizing and our quote form's "Size it for me". Give the product, how much goes in each bag (weight, volume or count) and the bag type (e.g. from recommend_bag_type); for solid pieces add the size of one piece. Returns the recommended outside size in inches and mm, how well it fits, and the sizing tool's own explanation. Our team confirms the final size on the written quote. To put the size on a quote request, pass sizing_reference to submit_quote_request.

bag_size.description: A bag size the customer already has in mind, with units, if any. The sizing tool checks it.
bag_size.title: Bag Size

fill_amount.description: How much goes in each bag: weight, volume or count, e.g. '12 oz', '250 g', '24 cookies'. Ask the customer; don't guess.
fill_amount.title: Fill Amount

format.description: Bag type, e.g. from recommend_bag_type. not_sure lets the sizing tool pick. Roll stock isn't sized.
format.title: Format

piece_size.description: For solid pieces (cookies, bars, jerky): the size of one piece with units, e.g. '4 x 4 x 1 in'.
piece_size.title: Piece Size

product.description: What goes in the bag, e.g. 'whole bean coffee'. Ask the customer; don't guess.
product.title: Product

name: recommend_bag_size
title: Recommend a bag size
